signal: EliseAI raised a $250M Series E in Aug 2025 at a $2.2B valuation and grew past 100 employees to nearly 600, expanding into healthcare

email.body1:
Matthew, saw EliseAI close the $250M Series E and scale toward 600 people while pushing into healthcare.

Growth that fast usually buries the SDR team in follow-up volume their headcount can't keep up with, and slow responses are where booked meetings slip. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so your reps spend time in live conversations: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I had our AI SDR draft three personalized emails to EliseAI's top target accounts. Want to hop on a quick call and I'll walk you through them?
email.body2:
Matthew, quick follow-up for EliseAI.

Scaling into a second vertical means new sequences, new personas, and longer ramp time for every SDR you add, and the volume tends to outrun the team fast. Most managers find the biggest leak is the second and third touch, not the first, where slow responses quietly cost booked meetings.

Worth 15 minutes? I'll walk you through a teardown of your current outbound, three specific things I'd change. Our best practices alone usually lift reply rates 50 to 70 percent.
email.body3:
Matthew, last bit of proof for EliseAI.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how your SDR team's reply rate likely compares to peer AI startups. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Matthew, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If freeing your SDRs from research and follow-up isn't a priority right now, no problem at all. Scaling a team this fast is its own kind of busy, and timing matters.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your SDR team? I'll tailor it to EliseAI either way.
